transcript: I noticed the missing society centered on pure human fulfillment and creativity. I would call this an expressive and empathetic commonwealth. What would matter most in this vision is a focus on mental well-being, artistic freedom and deep community connection. Instead of treating technology or law as the ultimate goal, this society uses them as a baseline infrastructure to free up human time, allowing individuals to focus entirely on personal growth, emotional connection, and creative exploration.
